test_title: PYST 13: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 20 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate title for the passage.

options.text: A Decade of POCSO Act and its Reflect
POCSO Act and the Lawyers’ Opinions

solution:
The correct answer is '**A Decade of POCSO Act and its Reflect**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses the completion of a decade since the enactment of the POCSO Act on 14 November 2022.
 
• It reviews **how the POCSO Act has met its objectives over the past decade**.
 
• It highlights the initial objectives of the Act, particularly in terms of creating a child-friendly judicial process.
 
• It addresses the hurdles and delays faced in the implementation of the Act across various states in India.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **POCSO, the Perfect Protection**: This title implies that the POCSO Act has been entirely effective and without flaws. However, the passage clearly mentions implementation challenges and the need for improvement, which makes this title unsuitable.
 
• **Lawlessness of POCSO Act**: This title suggests a complete failure or lack of enforcement of the POCSO Act, which is not the case as per the passage. The passage mentions improvements and increased sensitivity towards child victims, despite some hurdles.
 
• **POCSO Act and the Lawyers’ Opinions**: This title implies a focus on the opinions of legal professionals regarding the POCSO Act, which is not the main focus of the passage. The passage primarily deals with the implementation and impact of the Act over the past decade.
